meta.coverage: Complete 2017–2025 seasons; lagged team comparisons 2018–2025; partial 2026 excluded from statistical comparisons.
meta.injury_index_definition: 100 × team adjusted games lost / same-season NFL mean. 100 = NFL average; higher = greater injury burden.
meta.team_code_note: Franchise identities use current canonical codes; LA/STL→LAR, SD→LAC, OAK→LV. Historical names may differ.
meta.units_note: All keys named index use 100 as league average. Model raw relative_burden and sf_relative fields remain ratios as explicitly named.
meta.observational_caveat: Associations, nearest profiles, and predictive importance do not identify causes of injuries.

wild_cluster_bootstrap.method: Restricted wild cluster bootstrap; Rademacher team weights; same year fixed effects and controls.

caveats: Repeated franchise observations are not independent; intervals cluster or resample by franchise.
Healthy teams are more likely to reach the playoffs; a before/after increase is not the causal effect of playoff exposure.
Wide confidence intervals do not establish absence of meaningful harm.

feature_definitions.label: Snap-weighted age
feature_definitions.definition: Prior regular-season age on September 1 weighted by offensive plus defensive player snaps.

feature_definitions.label: Roster continuity
feature_definitions.definition: Prior-season share of snaps played by players also active for the same club one season earlier; not current-season roster retention.

feature_definitions.label: Regular-player concentration
feature_definitions.definition: Prior regular-season share of offensive plus defensive snaps played by the 22 most-used players.

feature_definitions.label: Regular-season playing volume
feature_definitions.definition: Prior regular-season offensive plus defensive player snaps divided by regular-season games; excludes special teams and practices.

feature_definitions.label: Recent playoff exposure
feature_definitions.definition: Franchise playoff games in the three preceding seasons; does not imply the same players participated in all games.

feature_definitions.label: Offensive run share
feature_definitions.definition: Prior-season carries divided by carries + pass attempts + sacks; includes scrambles and kneels and reflects game situation.

caveats: Injury burden and team identity excluded from clustering and choice of k.
Silhouette 0.181 and method sensitivity indicate overlapping broad profiles, not natural discrete types.
Nearest profiles must be computed from the six standardized features, not two-dimensional PCA.
The broad profile does not show a higher subsequent injury burden.

report_model.selection_criterion: 2023 average precision, two fixed models, no test tuning
report_model.target_description: New public physical-injury/condition report before the next scheduled regular-season game among eligible active, previously unreported players. Not medical injury incidence, severity, or games lost.
report_model.importance_unit: Average-precision points lost after grouped permutation on held-out 2024–25 data; not percent of injuries explained.
major_caveats: Direct-to-IR injuries and players not taking snaps can be missed.
Earlier weekly workload is not prior-year workload or proof of overtraining.
Permutation scores measure predictive usefulness, not causal effects.
Bootstrap intervals condition on the fitted model and omit some longitudinal dependence.
